keys.dialogDescription: For a single machine, which will join the "{fleet}" fleet and only see its machines.
keys.kindHypervisionHint: Client workstation that supervises its equipment remotely.
keys.kindEquipmentHint: NUC or Raspberry Pi installed on site, outside automatic enrollment.

keys.commandHint: Tailscale must be installed on the machine. The command registers it on the Stramatel network with this key.
